### Added
- `modelManager.networkPolicy.ingress.additionalPeers` and `agentManager.networkPolicy.ingress.additionalPeers` (default `[]`), in both charts: extra callers the model-manager / agent-manager ingress policies admit on the Service port next to the agentgateway data plane and muster — a list of pod label maps (`matchLabels`) in the release namespace, rendered as `fromEndpoints` entries with `io.kubernetes.pod.namespace` pinned to the release namespace (cilium) or as `podSelector` entries (kubernetes). A non-empty list counts as a platform caller, so the no-caller placeholder peer does not render next to it; an item that is not a non-empty label map fails the render. For an umbrella that runs a portal next to the managers (the standalone chart's Backstage, which patched the peer into its generated copies until now). `make verify-managers` covers it. **No installation needs to act**: the default render is unchanged.
